title: Lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology, Part-Time
bio: Dr. Suneel Kandru, CAGS, MScD, Cert. Ed., is an accomplished endodontist, healthcare innovator, and thought leader in the field of digital health. With a distinguished career spanning multiple prestigious institutions, including Harvard, Tufts, NYU Langone Health System, and Boston University, Kandru has established a reputation as a leading expert in endodontics and a driving force behind the transformation of the healthcare industry. As an experienced digital health consultant, he has helped shape the landscape of the industry, working with cutting-edge companies to implement innovative technologies aimed at improving patient access to care. With a passion for revolutionizing healthcare through the use of technology, he is at the forefront of healthcare innovation and continues to push the boundaries of what's possible.
